<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Abscission Shards](/Feats.aspx?ID=5440) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 68

**Archetype** [Clawdancer](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=221)

**Prerequisites**
[Clawdancer Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5436)

</column>

---

You twist your claw, breaking off a piece in your target. The shard deals 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). This increases to 2d6 if your unarmed attacks deal three weapon damage dice, such as under a [_greater striking_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) rune, and 3d6 if they deal four weapon damage dice.
name: Abscission Shards
